websiteFacts.claim: R.B. (Pete) Holden started Holden in 1978 by manufacturing and selling three-ring binders from a small parking garage at 2301 North Akard in Dallas.
Texas Instruments named Holden Vendor of the Year for product quality and customer service, and Holden received the recognition again in 2004 and 2006.
Holden entered the promotional products industry in 1992 as the business world moved toward a paperless future.
The Holden family became actively involved in 1992 as the company began transitioning to a second-generation family-owned business.
Holden began developing an in-house software platform in 2010 to improve its customer experience and internal operations, and launched the platform in 2014.
Holden offers more than 500,000 customizable products.
Holden offers branded products, packaging and kitting, custom apparel, and corporate gifting.
Holden works with customers throughout the process and tailors the experience to how each customer works best.
New customers can submit Holden's New Project Request Form to start a project.

websiteVoiceSamples.label: Company history
websiteVoiceSamples.content: R.B. (Pete) Holden envisions a business opportunity by manufacturing and selling three-ring binders. He starts his operation in a small parking garage at 2301 North Akard, across from what is now American Airlines Center. Holden is born and quickly becomes a nationwide supplier of professional business products.

websiteVoiceSamples.label: How Holden works
websiteVoiceSamples.content: We work with you every step of the way to create a unique promotional product and help your brand make an impact. We know what we’re doing, and we know that your business deserves a tailored experience. We don’t have to follow the same process every time – we work with you in the way that you work best.

websiteVoiceSamples.label: New project invitation
websiteVoiceSamples.content: Let’s Create Something Worth Talking About. Welcome! We’re excited to learn more about your project. To get started, please complete our New Project Request Form. Once submitted, a member of the Holden Brand team will review your request and follow up to begin the onboarding process.
